axe.name: axe-core
axe.limitation: Automated axe rules cover only part of WCAG; a scan cannot establish full WCAG conformance.

method: Installed headless Chrome/Edge; native label clicks and keyboard Tab; unsent checkbox values restored; computed text/background colours.
criteria: All 26 original controls per browser/viewport have unique IDs, associated purpose labels, matching accessibility snapshots when supported, and native label behaviour. Applicable target text contrast states meet 4.5:1. Raw axe naming/contrast rules must pass.
limitations: Automated technical retest only; no human acceptance or full WCAG conformance is claimed.
Noninteractive URL code has no keyboard-focus or active state; those states are N/A without modifying its semantics.
Contrast calculation supports solid alpha-composited CSS backgrounds; background images or ancestor opacity make a measurement BLOCKED.
